title: Summer museum guide
slide_intent: Use hierarchy to help visitors connect floors with content because a branded guide must support orientation as well as recognition.
strategic_value: A consistent uppercase hierarchy can carry Whitney’s voice from the cover to practical floor-by-floor information.
demonstration: A narrow Summer Museum Guide cover sits beside an unfolded four-panel guide headed Lower Gallery, First Floor, Second Floor and Third Floor.
practical_value: Compare the cover’s identity density with the open guide’s floor headings, text and artwork images.

content_islands.name: Cover
content_islands.spec: Place the narrow 2013 cover at left with the W, title and artwork.

content_islands.name: Floor panels
content_islands.spec: Show the unfolded guide at right with large floor names above supporting text and images.

reference_purposes.Application: The official caption identifies the object as the visitor guide available to museum visitors.
